name: Wayne M. Kalliomaa
office: Eastside Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Wayne M. Kalliomaa is a member of the Eastside Union School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 1. His term on the board began in February 2026. He retired in 2024 after a 35-year career at the Air Force Research Laboratory at Edwards AFB. He holds a degree in engineering physics from the University of Arizona. According to his district profile, he wants to provide a safe learning environment and ensure teachers and students have the resources they need.
